toolchain: Prebuilt by the PyInstaller maintainers (waf, MSVC); shipped unchanged in pyinstaller-6.21.0-py3-none-win_amd64.whl and in the sdist

configuration.bootloader_variant: Windows-64bit-intel/runw.exe (app, console=False) and run.exe or runw.exe (wsb_bridge.exe)

build_commands: PyInstaller (at app build time) copies the bootloader, appends the app archive and resources; the lane then signs both exes
correspondence: PyInstaller/bootloader/Windows-64bit-intel/run.exe and runw.exe are byte-identical in the pinned wheel and in the retained sdist (whose bootloader/ holds their sources); the two shipped exes are those bootloaders plus the appended archive and the signature, so they are path-reviewed signed rows.
